title: Solar System - Largest Planet
hint: This gas giant is the 5th planet from the Sun and is named after the king of the Roman gods.
prompt: What is the largest planet in our solar system? (Type your answer in the text box)

feedback.correct: Correct! Jupiter is indeed the largest planet in our solar system. It's so massive that it contains more than twice the mass of all other planets combined. Jupiter is a gas giant with a diameter of about 143,000 km (11 times Earth's diameter).
feedback.incorrect: The correct answer is Jupiter. It's the fifth planet from the Sun and by far the largest in our solar system. Jupiter is a gas giant - it has no solid surface and is mostly composed of hydrogen and helium.
